# Browser accessibility audit dependency

axe-core 4.10.3, published by Deque Systems, Inc., is vendored here solely for
repeatable browser QA without a CDN dependency. Its original copyright and
Mozilla Public License 2.0 notice remain in the file. Upstream package:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/axe-core/v/4.10.3

Automated WCAG checks supplement keyboard and screen-reader review; a clean
axe report does not certify complete accessibility.
